text:
ira: quick check on the invite modal + roles matrix compact rows. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/NEW/roles-compact (frames: CompactRows, InviteModalHelp).
tom: main questions: do we truncate role descriptions in compact view or provide an expand chevron?
liz: prefer expand chevron per row. for long orgs compact reduces vertical space but people still need quick access to perms details.
sam-a11y: a11y notes: make the chevron a real button with aria-expanded, and ensure the expanded content is `aria-live=\"polite\"` when revealed. also avoid relying on color alone for role severity badges.
ira: good. copy for the SSO toggle in invite modal - product wants short control + clarifying helper line. suggestions?
liz: control: "Require SSO" helper: "New invites must sign in via your org SSO. Existing members are unaffected." keeps it short and explicit.
tom: implementation note: switch should use `role=\"switch\" aria-checked` and helper linked with `aria-describedby`. also ensure the helper is focusable via keyboard for screen reader users.
sam-a11y: small keyboard trap found in audit-log filters: sticky header had `tabindex=0` making it take focus mid-tab sequence. remove tabindex from non-interactive containers and ensure filter chips are real buttons with visible 3px focus ring.
ci-bot: preview-deploy: roles-compact branch deployed to staging at 2025-09-10T10:22:18Z :rocket:
ira: next steps: liz to update figma with helper microcopy + expand chevron states, tom to convert chips to buttons and remove tabindex, sam to run quick a11y smoke on staging once merged. leaving thread open for staging feedback. :eyes:
